cases.rationale: A declared FastMCP entrypoint forwards its externally supplied URL through a keyword-only local helper.
The handler ignores its external URL and the helper receives a fixed destination.
A declared MCP tool accepts a path that directly selects a local file without confinement.
The externally supplied path is replaced by a fixed file before the read.
